safety_verdicts.content: Patient has a 4-day history of dry, itchy skin, located mainly on the chest and back.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts confirm ~4 days and chest involvement, but do not document involvement mainly on the back (they instead list chest/hands/arms). Thus the specific distribution 'chest and back' is not covered.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting back involvement slightly reduces accuracy of rash distribution, which can matter for differential diagnosis, but the record still captures a widespread pruritic rash and key affected areas. This is unlikely to change immediate management in an uncomplicated eczema flare.
